steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. I compared the two listings and they match on everything I could see:

| | Ottervale Audio (a) | Brackmoor Sound (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Colour and box contents | Graphite, case, USB-C and 3.5 mm cables | Graphite, case, USB-C and 3.5 mm cables |

The only difference is the seller name. Both listings show the same rating and the same 210 reviews. That may be a product-level rating and not a seller-level one, so it may not tell you anything about either seller.

Here's how I'd decide:
- **Check seller reputation elsewhere.** Look at independent reviews of Ottervale Audio and Brackmoor Sound. Pay attention to shipping speed, how they handle returns, and any complaints about counterfeit or open-box items.
- **Check the payment protection.** Pay by credit card or another method with buyer protection if you can.
- **Pick either one if you can't find anything.** Going by these pages alone, there's no reason to prefer one over the other.

If you tell me where else these sellers appear, such as a marketplace profile or a review site, I can look at that.
